metrics: The Provincial Health Services Authority's (PHSA) 22,000 employees work hard to improve the health and quality of life for every citizen in the province through specialized healthcare services offered close to where they live.

Project PANDA was still in the planning stage at the onset of the COVID-19 crisis. "In 2019, we were providing data analytics as a traditional nine-to-five service," says Ali Mussavi, Executive Director, Data Architecture and Governance at PHSA.

Not only did employees often have to file multiple requests to obtain the data they need, they also couldn't share that data with other teams within PHSA—even if those teams were working toward related public health benefits.
